# Three minute demo script

Live site: https://taadeel.onrender.com. The free tier may take up to a minute to wake up, so open the site before the demo starts. The UAE view uses synthetic data. Say so at the start and do not describe it as real legislation.

**0:00 to 0:20, framing.** Open the page. Point to the banner: "Taadeel is a research and navigation tool, not legal advice. The official Arabic text prevails." Point to the badge: "This view is synthetic test data, labelled on every response." Note the right to left layout and the bilingual labels.

**0:20 to 0:40, real view.** Switch the view to Real. "No real UAE law is loaded. The official portal returned HTTP 403 on its robots.txt file; that is recorded and not worked around. A permission request is drafted and has not been sent. The tool is link first."

**0:40 to 1:20, as of date.** Return to the synthetic view. Move the date slider across the amendment date. "The as of view shows what the text said on a date, with a source link and a retrieval date on every provision." Point to the state shown: certain, uncertain with candidate texts, or not in force. "If the effective date is not known, the page says uncertain and lists candidates instead of choosing one."

**1:20 to 1:50, redline.** Scroll to Changes. "Article level, word level, side by side redline. Inserted, replaced, repealed, renumbered and clarified are classed separately, and a low confidence match is flagged, not forced."

**1:50 to 2:20, UK validation corpus.** In Search, choose the UK validation corpus and search for a common legal term. "This is English UK legislation from legislation.gov.uk under the Open Government Licence v3.0. The attribution is shown. It validates the engine on English text and says nothing about UAE law."

**2:20 to 2:50, evidence slide.**

* Held out synthetic, v1: {v1_heldout_hits} of {v1_heldout_total} point predictions within tolerance, a calibration count. Alignment v2 on new seeds: {v2_verdict}
* UK English: {uk_oneday_correct} of {uk_oneday_shared} sections aligned in one day windows (easy cases). Point in time on the day before a change: {uk_pit_prior_correct} of {uk_pit_prior_total} with effects only. With snapshots: {tl_certain_correct} certain and correct, {tl_certain_wrong} certain and wrong, {tl_uncertain} uncertain of {tl_queries}, and the true text was among the candidates in {tl_uncertain_hit} of those.
* Synthetic Arabic stress set: v1 passes {ar_v1_ok} of {ar_cases}, v2 passes {ar_v2_ok}, by construction.

**2:50 to 3:00, limits.** "Nothing is validated on UAE law or on real Arabic legal text. UK numbers say nothing about UAE law. Schedules are excluded. Hand checks were done by the author, not a lawyer. Evaluations were pre registered and run once. Next: permission, a real Arabic gold set, and a reviewer."
